notablePrerequisites: You control an artifact that can tap to produce at least {C}.
description:
Activate an artifact by tapping it, adding at least {C}.
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Wernog.
When Wernog leaves and enters, it triggers twice, creating at least two Clue, two Food and two Treasure tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping two Clues, untapping the mana-producing artifact.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}.
Repeat.
